title_html: Horse Riding Gear and Tack for Every Discipline
body_html:
Whether you ride dressage, showjumping, eventing, or trail, selecting the right horse riding gear directly affects your comfort in the saddle and your horse's performance underneath it. At The Equestrian, we stock over 10,000 products from trusted Australian and international brands, covering everything a horse and rider need for training and competition across all disciplines.

A well-fitted saddle is the foundation of every ride. Paired with the correct bridle and horse bit, riders establish clear communication and control without compromising their horse's comfort. For riders who prefer bitless options, our range of bitless bridles offers gentle alternatives suited to sensitive horses and young horses in training. We also carry a full selection of girths, breastplates and martingales, reins, and stirrups from brands such as PS of Sweden, Equipe, and Prestige.

Protecting your horse during work is equally important. Our horse boots collection includes jumping boots, tendon boots, bell boots, and float boots from Veredus, Woof Wear, and Cryochaps. Combined with quality saddle pads from Kentucky Horsewear and PS of Sweden, you can ensure proper shock absorption and back protection for every session.

title_html: Riding Clothes and Footwear for Australian Conditions
body_html:
Choosing the right riding clothes means balancing comfort, safety, and the specific demands of Australian conditions - hot summers, cold mornings, and everything between. Our rider apparel collection is built around practical performance fabrics that wick moisture, stretch with your movement, and hold up to daily stable work.

For everyday riding, lightweight riding tights and breeches are the most popular choices among our customers. In the competition ring, correct presentation matters - our range of competition jackets and show shirts helps riders meet dress standards for dressage, showjumping, and showing events across Australia. We also carry a full kids clothing range including kids breeches for young riders.

Footwear is where comfort and safety intersect. A quality pair of riding boots with a defined heel and supportive sole gives you stability in the stirrup and grip on the ground. We carry women's riding boots, men's boots, and children's options from Ariat, Tucci, and other trusted brands - whether you need paddock boots for daily wear, tall boots for competition, or durable work boots for long hours around the stable.

title_html: Horse Health, Nutrition, and Stable Essentials
body_html:
Keeping your horse healthy starts with consistent daily care. The Equestrian stocks a comprehensive range of horse supplements to support joint health, gut function, coat condition, and recovery after hard work. From electrolytes for hydration during hot Australian summers to calming supplements for horses in new environments, we carry products that address the specific health challenges faced by horses in Australian conditions.

Routine hoof care and a reliable worming program are two areas where consistent attention prevents larger problems. We also carry horse feed options and fly repellent products to support horses through every season. For stable comfort and enrichment, our horse treats and toys keep horses content and mentally stimulated during downtime. Everything you need for daily stable management - from hay nets and feed bins to leather care - is available with free shipping across Australia.

Seasonal protection is another consideration for Australian horse owners. Our horse rugs collection covers winter rugs, summer rugs, rain sheets, and travel rugs, so your horse stays comfortable in paddock and stable all year round.

title_html: Premium Equestrian Brands Trusted by Australian Riders
body_html:
The quality of your horse and rider equipment is determined by the brands behind it. The Equestrian partners with over 50 leading equestrian brands from Australia and around the world, giving riders access to the same gear used by professional competitors and trusted by everyday riders across the country.

Kentucky Horsewear is one of our most sought-after brands for saddle pads, horse boots, and stable accessories, known for their quality materials and functional design. For tack, Equipe and Prestige deliver Italian-crafted saddles and bridles built for performance across dressage, showjumping, and eventing. PS of Sweden bridles have become a favourite among competitive riders for their ergonomic design and attention to horse comfort, while Ariat remains the go-to brand for riding boots, jeans, and casual equestrian footwear. Cavalleria Toscana offers premium European rider apparel for those who value style alongside function, and BARE Equestrian is an Australian favourite for riding tights and training wear.

We ship every order with free delivery across Australia, and our team of experienced equestrians is available to help you find the right product for your horse and your discipline.
